summaryZh: Hargreaves 实验室研究 BAF 染色质重塑复合物介导的表观遗传调控，尤其是疾病中的免疫细胞激活。团队采用生物化学和表观基因组检测，研究癌症相关 BAF 突变对治疗和免疫治疗反应的影响，并探索 BAF 抑制剂的治疗潜力。
researchQuestions: BAF复合体亚基中的癌症相关突变如何影响治疗响应，尤其是免疫治疗响应？

evidence.quote: The Hargreaves lab is interested in epigenetic regulation mediated by BAF chromatin remodeling complexes.
Our goal is to use biochemical and epigenomic assays to understand BAF complex regulation of immune cell activation in disease.
We also have a strong interest in understanding how cancer-associated mutations in BAF complex subunits impact therapeutic responses, particularly to immunotherapy.
